title: Intermediate Backend Engineer, Platform Readiness
jd_text:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. 
 The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems.  Co-create the future with us  as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. 
 * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.    GitLab features must ship successfully across four distinct deployment platforms—Self-Managed, Dedicated, Dedicated for Government, and GitLab.com. Today, developers routinely discover platform compatibility issues late in development, triggering costly rework, delays, and emergency escalations. The Platform Readiness team is building an internal developer tooling capability that embeds platform readiness intelligence directly into GitLab's software development lifecycle to solve this problem. 
 As an Intermediate Backend Engineer on the newly established Platform Readiness functional team in Developer Experience, you'll contribute to the systems that enable features to ship successfully across all platforms by building and maintaining agentic workflow components and evolving the platform requirements knowledge base. This is a growth opportunity: you will learn the Platform Readiness team's agentic workflows, requirements schema, and integration surfaces from other engineers and team leadership. You'll work on concrete, high-impact problems while developing expertise in platform readiness automation and AI-driven systems. 
 What you'll do 
 
  Build and maintain agentic workflow components  on the Duo Agent Platform: contribute to the Core Agentic Workflow (DAP flow) and the Requirements Agent; write tests, documentation, and evaluations for agentic-workflow behavior 
  Contribute to the platform requirements knowledge base : add requirements, evolve the schema, and improve validation tooling; work with platform teams to translate their expertise into structured requirements 
  Build integration surfaces  that enable feature teams to engage the Platform Readiness team where they already work: issues, merge requests, design documents, and CI/CD pipelines 
  Collaborate with platform teams  (Infrastructure, Security, Data) to translate their expertise into platform readiness artifacts and domain skills 
  Write clear and concise documentation and evaluations  that validate agentic-workflow behavior and improve assessment accuracy 
 
 What you'll bring 
 Required Experience & Skills 
 
  2+ years of software engineering experience  with backend focus 
  Proficiency in TypeScript/Node,  Python, or Golang  
  Comfort reading and contributing to schemas  (YAML, JSON Schema) and structured content 
  Experience with and operational exposure to Kubernetes  and reasoning about failure modes 
  Ability to work asynchronously  and communicate clearly in written form 
  Exposure to and experience with LLM APIs, prompts, or agentic frameworks  (does not need to be incredibly extensive)

1、理解战斗机制，使用3D引擎搭建符合玩法需求的关卡白模；

title: 招聘专家-国际化广告
jd_text:

5、分析招聘数据及漏斗，提升招聘有效性。

title: 魔方在研轻动作风格化游戏预研项目战斗策划
jd_text:
1.负责战斗体系的设计、迭代，以及规则机制、角色技能的设计与制作；
2.与程序、美术团队紧密配合，推动怪物、职业技能、地图等从玩法机制、数值设计、美术包装、实机表现的完整落地；
3.设计玩法的经济数值循环系统，确保对局内和跨局间玩家追求与平衡性、数值不膨胀溢出；
4.实时跟踪用户反馈及对战数据，针对潜在问题或风险进行合理分析，并进行及时跟进解决；
5.基于后台数据和玩家反馈，优化和迭代战斗技能设计并复盘制作标准，指导开发新内容，保持玩法的新鲜度和吸引力。

title: 微信小游戏-游戏引擎开发工程师
jd_text:
1.游戏引擎适配与渲染优化：面向 Unity/UE/Godot等商业引擎及自研引擎，推进重度游戏在微信小游戏平台的引擎层适配、渲染管线调优与性能突破，帮助更多高品质游戏以更低研发成本进入微信生态；
2.游戏性能分析与调优攻坚：研发性能分析工具链，优化内存、渲染、运行性能、启动链路等核心指标与瓶颈定位，协助头部游戏完成性能优化；
3.小游戏平台前沿技术研究：建设更强的平台图形与运行时基础设施，提升游戏内存效率、渲染效率与运行流畅度；
4.技术支持服务：为平台开发者提供引擎与性能方向的深度技术支持与问题攻坚，沉淀调优方法论与最佳实践，推动技术能力在生态内规模化复用。

4.跟进上线数据、用户反馈及线上问题，推动版本优化与复盘，持续完善版本管理流程和协作效率。

title: 在研UE5射击游戏-关卡策划
jd_text:

3.负责关卡上线后的跟进，关注相关统计数据，调研问卷，论坛，游戏网站等体现具体使用情况和玩家反馈的来源，必要时根据数据和反馈来制定后续优化方案并跟进具体开发；
4.积极参与产品相关设计及优化工作，完善工作流程，注重产品表现，参与产品测试，不断发现产品不足及有待提高的方面。

title: 游戏技术美术工程师（无限大）
jd_text:
1.有较好的美术专业和审美能力，熟悉游戏美术各类资源开发的流程和规范；
2.美术向 - 精通（场景、角色、动画特效）至少一条美术专业线的资源生产，为美术和技术之间搭建桥梁，解决美术开发中的问题；
3.渲染向 - 熟悉引擎渲染相关技术，Shader材质代码编写和制作，精通至少一种脚本语言；
4.熟悉UE4、Unity引擎特性和功能，有三端（主机、PC、移动）之一的平台项目开发经验；
5.有钻研精神，持续学习掌握先进开发技术和工具，并成功引入到项目开发中；
6.开展针对美术技术相关的培训；
7.有大世界开发经验者优先。 1、引擎渲染技术相关的研究，解决美术、策划日常遇到的技术问题；
2、根据具体职能，完成渲染开发、程序化生成或其他美术效果的实现及性能优化；
3、熟悉并研究引擎各项功能，帮助美术人员高效的使用引擎，并根据项目的需求制作各种提升生产效率的插件；
4、充分了解美术各环节开发中的需求和问题，与美术、程序紧密结合，提供足够的技术支持；
5、根据项目开发中策划、美术和程序的变化，不断维护、优化美术工作流、工具链，依据性能测试制定美术资源开发的技术规范；
6、编写技术文档，参与TA技术库的建设。

title: 广告营销策划（游戏方向）
jd_text:
1、3-5年以上广告营销工作经验；
2、有游戏代理公司、4A广告公司、大型互联网公司创意策划岗位经验者优先，做过游戏、快消行业营销者优先； 
3、策略和创意能力强，具有独立撰写方案和提案的能力； 
4、逻辑思维能力强，善于交际沟通，口语表达能力强，并具有较强的时间管理能力； 
5、能吃苦耐劳，能承受较大的工作压力和快节奏的工作； 
6、有强烈的工作激情，诚信，正能量且积极，良好的服务意识和团队合作精神；
7、加分项：会精美大气的ppt排版，有ppt审美；  1. 创意型思维：有趣的灵魂，发散式的创意思维，能够独立产出活动创意、亮点玩法，强创意型人才，有丰富的想象力和敏锐的内容创意力； 
2. 客户需求解读：能够通过解读Brief，分析客户需求，独立完成项目方案撰写。有优秀的方案产出能力和快速成案的工作效率。 
3. 行业及岗位经验：本职位为实际撰写岗位，岗位日常产出为PPT形式，需熟悉游戏行业、大快消、IT 3C等行业，且有客户竞标方案独立撰写经验。如过往只是浅度参与方案，非主撰写角色，勿扰；
4. 提案能力：优秀的表达力，可支持销售去客户方提案， 并进行销售培训； 
5. 业绩目标达成意识：针对方案的变现，有目标达成意识，与团队一起达成销售业绩目标。 
6. 数据包装与结案：进行数据包装与梳理，并支持结案撰写；

title: 广告创意策划（海外品牌方向）
jd_text:
1. 拥有3-5年及以上广告营销相关从业经验；
2. 具备4A广告公司、头部互联网平台创意策划任职经历优先；有游戏、快消行业全案营销实操经验、品牌出海项目经验者优先；
3. 策略底层逻辑扎实，创意产出能力突出，可独立完成整套营销方案撰写，并独立完成客户提案宣讲；
4. 逻辑清晰缜密，擅长对内对外跨角色沟通，口头表达流畅出彩；具备优秀时间规划能力，可多项目并行有序推进；
5. 网感敏锐，熟悉各类社交媒体传播逻辑，拥有粉丝运营、线上互动营销实操经验者优先；
6. 抗压能力强，适配广告行业高强度、快节奏工作模式，可主动承接紧急项目与阶段性加班工作；
7. 工作热情饱满，为人正直诚信，心态积极正向；具备良好客户服务意识与协同共进的团队精神；
8. 加分项：具备优秀PPT审美，擅长精致、高级的PPT视觉排版与页面美化。 1、拥有发散创意思维与敏锐内容感知力，独立产出主题创意、特色内容营销玩法、话题炒作、事件营销，擅长打造差异化热点；
2、精准解读客户需求，本职位为实际撰写岗位，岗位日常产出为PPT形式，故候选人需有独立完成全案撰写的实操经验，方案产出质量高、出案效率快。如过往只是浅度参与方案，非主撰写角色，勿扰；
3、行业经验：需熟悉大快消、IT 3C等行业，有游戏客户全案竞标撰写及海外客户全案竞标撰写能力者加分； 
4、线下提案表达流畅，可支持销售对接客户宣讲方案，并负责销售策划技能培训；
5、具备强商业变现意识，协同团队攻坚，助力业绩目标达成；
6、依托项目数据完成整合结案的包装，独立撰写标准化结案复盘。

3、负责对团队员工进行弱电技能培训和能力培养，组织训练与演练；
4、负责弱电系统相关工程的现场监督并参与竣工验收评审；
5、持续优化数据中心弱电系统，与团队配合持续优化运营成本和可靠性。

title: 关卡策划（JRPG） - Bluesea Studio
jd_text:
团队介绍：Bluesea工作室成立于2024年8月，当前涉足卡牌/RPG/SLG/竞技等多个品类，已经上线的游戏《放置少女》，各类新产品已蓄势待发。欢迎加入我们！

1、负责游戏关卡相关设计，包括但不限于活动副本、场景交互解密探索、各类PVP竞技玩法等相关设计和制作工作；
2、与战斗、文案、系统、数值等其他环节策划深入合作，优化关卡设计，调优关卡体验；
3、与程序合作，研发、优化并维护关卡编辑器；
4、与美术合作，积极跟进相关美术资产的落地工作。

3、参与国际化亿级用户的播放体验、稳定性和成本等优化等。

title: 在研UE5射击游戏-游戏客户端开发-gameplay方向
jd_text:
1.核心 Gameplay 开发：负责 UE5 项目局内模式玩法及核心模块（道具、技能、战斗、关卡流程等）的设计与开发；
2.玩法架构设计：负责局内玩法框架与规则系统的架构设计；
3.负责大地图玩法的客户端逻辑设计、加载与卸载策略调优及玩法结合落地；
4.客户端帧率/内存优化及玩家操作体验打磨。

title: PUBG Mobile-3D特效设计师-重构
jd_text:

4.负责统筹分配重构模块工作，管理重构V岗人员，负责V岗产出和质量。

title: 《逆战：未来》战斗策划（构筑）
jd_text:
1.负责游戏内结合武器的天赋/战斗构筑设计、原型制作以及需求验收/调优，和程序/美术等部门的同事紧密合作推动落地；
2.对标顶尖射击PVE游戏进行设计拆解，攻坚职业技能的设计，持续推出独特有趣的战斗体验，独立完成标杆的打造和验证，并不断提升技能整体表现和3C的品质；
3.参与战斗模块整体能力构架&战斗平衡性测试和调优，提升整体战斗感受。

3.负责分析、定位、解决项目的疑难问题，以及对体验和性能方面的调优。

title: UE微恐轻动作项目-资深玩法开发工程师
jd_text:
1.负责玩法三大模块：战斗、怪物、关卡的系统设计与落地；
2.参与战斗数值调试、怪物属性配置及关卡触发机制迭代，保障体验流畅；
3.协助美术/策划建立高效的游戏内容制作流程, 完善并持续优化工具链。

title: UE微恐轻动作项目-2D场景设计接口人
jd_text:
1.配合主美，深度参与项目场景视觉风格、色彩系统、图形语言、品质标准的整体制定与落地执行；
2.负责游戏场景世界观与视觉基调搭建，输出强形式感、高辨识度、新美学的场景概念 / 气氛图 / 关键帧视觉；
3.以图形构成、平面化语言、极简叙事、强对比、符号化设计为核心能力，完成空间、建筑、地貌、氛围的整体设计；
4.把控构图节奏、色彩系统、视觉层级、风格统一，让场景具备传播力与记忆点；
5.输出可落地、可拼接、可扩展的场景规范与视觉指南，配合 3D / 地编实现最终高品质呈现，和LD、LA协同，对整体游戏场景的设计和落地质量负责；
6.参与视觉创新探索，持续输出新风格、新表现、新语言，提升项目整体美术壁垒。

title: 《三角洲行动》-经济数值（海外）
jd_text:
1.负责烽火地带模式在海外的经济数值设计；
2.针对烽火地带海外的玩家经济数据和玩法数据做持续跟踪和分析，产出优化方向；
3.和系统、活跃等模块合作，协调国服相关成员，完成内容落地并进行数据验证。

title: 腾讯云-运营开发高级工程师
jd_text:
1.负责腾讯海量服务器运营系统建设，保障腾讯云服务器的稳定运行；
2.负责腾讯海量服务器的管理控制系统的建设；
3.负责腾讯海量服务器的硬件故障监控和预警系统建设；
4.深刻理解业务需求，负责系统的架构设计、代码实现、代码维护、容灾机制及迭代更新优化，保证需求交付质量；
5.负责编写相关的技术文档、单元测试，对代码质量负责。

title: UE微恐轻动作项目-资深3D场景设计师（灯光方向）
jd_text:
1.负责项目场景灯光氛围设计与制作，制定场景灯光风格标准及规范；
2.配合LD、LA及场景团队完成不同关卡与区域的灯光表现落地；
3.负责场景光影、情绪氛围、镜头表现及最终视觉效果把控；
4.持续探索风格化灯光表现及实时渲染效果优化方案。

title: 关卡策划专家
jd_text:
1、有丰富的各平台单机游戏体验经历，尤其在动作冒险和角色扮演向作品方面有深刻体验，总体验时长不低于300小时，体验作品数量不少于10部；
2、有手绘关卡原型与同事沟通讨论，并在引擎中实现关卡原型，测试并调整的能力；
3、能够在场景的视觉引导、摄像机设置、场景视觉核心元素设计方面有经验和见解；
4、重视关卡与叙事，关卡与视觉等体验的契合度；
5、有3A项目关卡设计经验者优先；

ABOUT POSTHOG

Product development used to mean manually writing code, running analysis, diagnosing bugs, and rolling out changes using dozens of tools.

PostHog is the only platform that acts like a co-pilot for you (and your AI agents) to do it all – autonomously.

 - PostHog AI https://posthog.com/ai, an AI-powered analyst that answers product questions, helps users find useful session recordings, and writes custom SQL queries.

We are:

 1. Product-led. More than 450,000 organizations have installed PostHog, mostly driven by word-of-mouth. We have intensely strong product-market fit.

 3. Well-funded. We've raised more than $180m from some of the world's top investors. We're set up for a long, ambitious journey.

We're focused on building an awesome product for end users, hiring exceptional teammates, shipping fast, and being as weird as possible https://posthog.com/deskhog. 

 




THINGS WE CARE ABOUT

 - Transparency: Everyone can read about our roadmap, how we pay (or even let go of) people, our strategy, and how we work, in our public company handbook https://posthog.com/handbook. Internally, we share revenue, notes and slides from board meetings, and fundraising plans, so everyone has the context they need to make good decisions.

 - Autonomy: We don’t tell anyone what to do. Everyone chooses what to work on next based on what's going to have the biggest impact on our customers, and what they find interesting and motivating to work on. Engineers lead product teams https://posthog.com/handbook/wide-company and make product decisions https://posthog.com/handbook/which-products. Teams are flexible and easy to change when needed.

 - Shipping fast: Why not now? https://posthog.com/handbook/values#why-not-now We want to build a lot of products; we can't do that shipping at a normal pace. We've built the company around small teams – autonomous, highly-efficient groups of cracked engineers https://posthog.com/founders/cracked-manifesto who can outship much larger companies because they own their products end-to-end.

 - Time for building: Nothing gets shipped in a meeting. We're a natively remote company. We default to async communication – PRs > Issues > Slack. Tuesdays and Thursdays are meeting-free days https://posthog.com/handbook/company/culture#were-on-the-makers-schedule, and we prioritize heads down building time over perfect coordination. This will be the most productive job you've ever had.

 - Ambition: We want to solve big problems. We strongly believe that aiming for the best possible upside, and sometimes missing, is better than never trying. We're optimistic about what's possible and our ability to get there.

 - Being weird: Weird means redesigning an already world-class website for the 5th time. It means shipping literally every product that relates to customer data. jd_text:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. 
 The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems.  Co-create the future with us  as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. 
 * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.     An overview of this role  
 As the Manager, IT SOX PMO, you'll own information technology (IT)-specific Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance activities and serve as a subject matter expert for IT general controls (ITGCs) and IT application controls (ITACs). You will be an individual contributor, reporting to the Senior Director, SOX PMO Leader within the Chief Accounting Officer's organization, you'll directly support the Senior Manager, IT SOX PMO in strengthening GitLab's IT SOX program, preparing new and changing processes and systems for SOX requirements, and advancing automation in a high-growth technology environment. You'll combine strategic guidance with hands-on execution by improving current processes, assessing emerging technologies for SOX impact, and applying practical, scalable control practices. 
  What you’ll do  
 
 Serve as an IT SOX subject matter expert for ITGCs and ITACs, providing guidance and supporting compliance with SOX requirements. 
 Partner with the business SOX Program Management Office (PMO) to assess SOX readiness for new or changing systems and business processes, and support the annual IT SOX risk assessment. 
 Maintain and improve control documentation, including flowcharts, risk and control matrices, and control inventories. 
 Facilitate IT control walkthroughs and coordinate the remediation of control deficiencies. 
 Coordinate with internal and external auditors throughout the SOX audit cycle, clearly presenting positions and supporting appropriate conclusions. 
 Review System and Organization Controls (SOC) reports and oversee the key report testing program with contractor support, performing hands-on testing when needed. 
 Build cross-functional relationships, including a close partnership with Internal Audit on SOX testing execution. 
 Identify opportunities for control automation, monitor emerging risks and regulatory changes, including those related to artificial intelligence (AI), and help prepare reports and presentation materials on SOX compliance status. 
 
  What you’ll bring  
 
 A bachelor's degree in information technology, computer science, accounting, or a related field. 
 IT audit and SOX compliance experience, including deep knowledge of ITGCs, ITACs, and control frameworks such as Control Objectives for Information and Related Technologies (COBIT) and the Committee of Sponsoring Organizations of the Treadway Commission (COSO) framework.

  Support  a collaborative team model where product managers share ownership across a common pool of work and step into the areas where they can have the most impact.

title: AIGC视频内容专家（编导方向）（北京）

主要从影视工业的专业视角，主导AI视频模型在训练数据规划与生成内容质量评测方面的工作，确保其输出内容在叙事和艺术性上达到高标准。

1.训练数据分析与规划：​ 参与制定多模态视频模型的数据策略，从叙事结构、镜头语言等专业角度评估和指导训练数据的质量与方向；
2.专业评测体系研究：​ 牵头构建针对AI生成视频的专业评测维度与方法论，重点关注内容的逻辑性、观赏性及艺术表现力；
3.内容质量评估与迭代推动：​ 对模型生成结果进行专业评审，提供具象、可执行的反馈，协同技术团队推动模型效果的持续优化；
4.AIGC应用探索：​ 主动探索并实践前沿AIGC视频工具，将实际应用洞察反哺至数据与评测策略中。

Co-create the future with us  as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.     An overview of this role  
 As a Senior Revenue Analytics Analyst, you'll be a key partner to our global Sales Strategy, Solutions Architect and Ecosystem teams, using data to improve how we engage in the pre-sales motion, tie trials of our products into consumption, and demonstrate how our Partners influence winning deals and resulting consumption. You'll translate questions from Solution Architect, Sales Strategy, and Ecosystem partners into clear analytical requirements. You'll explore customer engagement, adoption, and satisfaction data and turn findings metrics to build AI tools, analytics, and insights that Field Operations stakeholders can rely on. Working closely with Revenue Analytics teammates and cross-functional stakeholders, you'll build and maintain analytics foundations that power one-to-many engagements, digital touchpoints, and automation. You'll experiment with AI and legacy tech stack tooling to increase speed to insight. You'll also advocate for data quality, consistency, and clear definitions as you shape how we measure and understand customer health and outcomes. 
  What you'll do  
 
 Partner with Solution Architect, Sales Strategy, Ecosystem, and other Go-To-Market stakeholders and teammates to translate questions about pre-sales engagement, consumption, pipeline, and sales efficiency into clear analytical requirements. 
 Design and build AI and analytic solutions that provide actionable insights for trial management, win rates, adoption, conversion, and overall sales metrics. 
 Craft well-structured, maintainable solutions in both business intelligence and AI tools that follow internal standards and make it easy for customer-facing teams to monitor performance and take action. 
 Partner with operational and data teams to define requirements for stakeholders and engagement data models, shaping how data is collected, structured, and made available for analysis. 
 Use segmentation, cohort analysis, and experimentation techniques, such as A/B testing, to inform scaled engagement strategies and forecast the impact of digital programs. 
 Serve as a subject matter expert in sales analytics by sharing best practices, documenting logic and methodologies, and providing guidance to help partners and other analysts use data to make better decisions. 
 
  What you'll bring  
 
 Experience in analytics roles focused on pre-sales motions and SaaS, including analyzing customer engagement, adoption, and health across the customer lifecycle. 
 Background combining data from multiple customer and go-to-market systems to create a unified view of pre-sales and Partner engageme

 As a Lead People Systems Engineer, you'll drive how GitLab's People systems evolve through an AI-first transformation mindset, putting AI to work across everything we build. You won't just support our people systems, you'll build them: owning the code, pipelines, and integrations that keep GitLab's People automation ecosystem running reliably at scale across Workato, Google Cloud, Claude, Workday, and the tools that power our global workforce. This is a strong fit if you think like a software engineer first, write clean and maintainable code, and thrive at the intersection of people systems, AI, innovation, and automation engineering. 
 In this role, you'll be the technical backbone of our People Technology team, designing, building, and maintaining the automations, agents, and integrations that connect Workday, Greenhouse, Slack, and internal tools. You'll be the go-to technical thought partner for the people group on complex engineering decisions, and your work will compound over time: fewer manual processes, stronger system reliability, and a People technology foundation that scales without friction. 
  What You’ll Do    
 
 Own the design, development, and maintenance of people system automations and integrations across Workato, Google Cloud Platform, Claude, Workday, Greenhouse and GitLab, writing reliable, well-tested code that runs at scale. 
 Build and maintain integrations between Workday, Greenhouse, Slack, and internal tools using Workday Web Services (WWS) and Slack's API and Bot SDK, diagnosing failures proactively and driving uptime and reliability improvements across the automation stack. 
 Write, version, and maintain automation code in Ruby (or comparable scripting languages) stored in GitLab, with clear documentation, code reviews, and disciplined change management practices. 
 Develop and manage Slack apps and bots that deliver intuitive, automated workflows, reducing friction for People teams and employees across a globally distributed workforce. 
 Move past surface-level requests to diagnose root problems, challenge assumptions, and co-design automation solutions that are durable, scalable, and built to last. 
 Serve as subject matter expert on Workato automation architecture, driving standardization, reusability, and scalability across the People technology integration layer. 
 Maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines and deployment practices for People system automation, ensuring changes are tested, reviewed, and safely deployed using GitLab.

title: 服务运营负责人-抖音电商 - 抖音电商
jd_text:
团队介绍：抖音电商致力于成为用户发现丰富好物的首选平台。众多抖音创作者通过短视频、直播、商城等丰富的形式，给用户提供更个性化、更生动、更高效的消费体验。同时，抖音电商积极引入优质合作伙伴，为商家变现提供多元的选择。

1、负责服务运营体系的设计与优化，围绕成本、体验、效率持续提升消费者问题解决体验；负责服务商运营管理，提升执行质量与交付效率；结合消费者反馈洞察问题，推动客服系统产品及服务方案优化；
2、服务流程设计与优化：从成本、体验和效率角度设计并持续优化服务流程，提升消费者问题解决体验与运营效率；
3、服务商运营管理：负责服务商管理与运营，持续提升服务执行质量和效率；
4、问题洞察与优化推动：基于消费者反馈和服务问题，识别客服系统产品及服务方案的优化机会，并推动改进落地。

jd_text:
ABOUT POSTHOG

Product development used to mean manually writing code, running analysis, diagnosing bugs, and rolling out changes using dozens of tools.

PostHog is the only platform that acts like a co-pilot for you (and your AI agents) to do it all – autonomously.

We started with open-source product analytics, launched out of Y Combinator's W20 cohort https://posthog.com/handbook/story. We've since shipped more than a dozen products https://posthog.com/products, including:

 - PostHog Code https://posthog.com/code, the only AI devtool that understands your product, not just your codebase.

 - A built-in data warehouse https://posthog.com/docs/data-warehouse, so users can query product and customer data together using custom SQL insights.

 - PostHog AI https://posthog.com/ai, an AI-powered analyst that answers product questions, helps users find useful session recordings, and writes custom SQL queries.

We are:

 1. Product-led. More than 450,000 organizations have installed PostHog, mostly driven by word-of-mouth. We have intensely strong product-market fit.

 2. Default alive https://paulgraham.com/aord.html. Revenue is growing incredibly quickly, and we're very efficient. We raise money to push ambition and grow faster, not to keep the lights on.

 3. Well-funded. We've raised more than $180m from some of the world's top investors. We're set up for a long, ambitious journey.

We're focused on building an awesome product for end users, hiring exceptional teammates, shipping fast, and being as weird as possible https://posthog.com/deskhog. 

 


THINGS WE CARE ABOUT

 - Transparency: Everyone can read about our roadmap, how we pay (or even let go of) people, our strategy, and how we work, in our public company handbook https://posthog.com/handbook. Internally, we share revenue, notes and slides from board meetings, and fundraising plans, so everyone has the context they need to make good decisions.

 - Autonomy: We don’t tell anyone what to do. Everyone chooses what to work on next based on what's going to have the biggest impact on our customers, and what they find interesting and motivating to work on. Engineers lead product teams https://posthog.com/handbook/wide-company and make product decisions https://posthog.com/handbook/which-products. Teams are flexible and easy to change when needed.

 - Shipping fast: Why not now? https://posthog.com/handbook/values#why-not-now We want to build a lot of products; we can't do that shipping at a normal pace. We've built the company around small teams – autonomous, highly-efficient groups of cracked engineers https://posthog.com/founders/cracked-manifesto who can outship much larger companies because they own their products end-to-end.

 - Time for building: Nothing gets shipped in a meeting. We're a natively remote company. We default to async communication – PRs > Issues > Slack. Tuesdays and Thursdays are meeting-free days https://posthog.com/handbook/company/culture#were-on-the-makers-schedule, and we prioritize heads down building time over perfect coordination. This will be the most productive job you've ever had.

 - Ambition: We want to solve big problems. We strongly believe that aiming for the best possible upside, and sometimes missing, is better than never trying. We're optimistic about what's possible and our ability to get there.

 - Being weird: Weird means redesigning an already world-class website for the 5th time. It means shipping literally every product that relates to customer data. It means building an objectively unnecessary developer toy https://posthog.com/deskhog with dubious shareholder value. Doing weird stuff is a competitive advantage. And it's fun.


WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

We're seeking a Europe/UK based ingestion pipeline engineer who:

 - Thrives on challenges of building systems that process billions of events per day

 - Gets excited about designing elegant and efficient systems that can handle terabytes of data without giving people insomnia

Everyone chooses what to work on next based on what's going to have the biggest impact on our customers, and what they find interesting and motivating to work on. Engineers lead product teams https://posthog.com/handbook/wide-company and make product decisions https://posthog.com/handbook/which-products. Teams are flexible and easy to change when needed.

 - Shipping fast: Why not now? https://posthog.com/handbook/values#why-not-now We want to build a lot of products; we can't do that shipping at a normal pace. We've built the company around small teams – autonomous, highly-efficient groups of cracked engineers https://posthog.com/founders/cracked-manifesto who can outship much larger companies because they own their products end-to-end.

 - Time for building: Nothing gets shipped in a meeting. We're a natively remote company. We default to async communication – PRs > Issues > Slack. Tuesdays and Thursdays are meeting-free days https://posthog.com/handbook/company/culture#were-on-the-makers-schedule, and we prioritize heads down building time over perfect coordination. This will be the most productive job you've ever had.

 - Ambition: We want to solve big problems. We strongly believe that aiming for the best possible upside, and sometimes missing, is better than never trying. We're optimistic about what's possible and our ability to get there.

 - Being weird: Weird means redesigning an already world-class website for the 5th time. It means shipping literally every product that relates to customer data.  As Engineering Manager, Growth at GitLab, you’ll focus on building and enabling a high-performing team that helps users discover, activate, and expand value in GitLab. Growth’s mission is full-funnel: linking acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, and monetization into measurable self-serve loops, while using experimentation to improve how users experience the product. 
 Your primary focus will be to hire, coach, and develop team members, and to create an environment where they can do their best work while delivering strong results. You’ll partner closely with Product, Design, Data, and Engineering stakeholders to translate business goals, user journey insights, and experiment learnings into product improvements that help users realize value faster. 
 You will foster a culture that challenges the status quo and leverages AI-native experimentation to find innovative solutions for our users. 
 You and your globally distributed team will work in an agile and asynchronous way, working across GitLab to run experiments on GitLab.com, improve onboarding and discoverability, and streamline the paths that connect users to existing product value. Growth teams work iteratively, operate across product areas, and use experimentation to make data-informed product choices. 
 In this role, you’ll balance technical guidance with people management. You’ll guide architecture and implementation discussions, help the team navigate tradeoffs, and ensure experiments and product changes are built carefully, measured well, and aligned with long-term product ownership. Because Growth often works across product boundaries, you’ll also help your team work effectively with counterpart groups and smoothly hand off or scale successful work where ongoing ownership belongs elsewhere. 
 Some examples of our projects: 
 
 
 Improving signup, onboarding, and activation experiences to help new users get to value faster 
 
 
 Running experiments and A/B tests on GitLab.com to improve discoverability, conversion, engagement, and upgrade flows

title: Senior Backend Engineer, AI Engineering: Chat
jd_text:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. 
 The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems.  Co-create the future with us  as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. 
 * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.     An overview of this role  
 As a Senior Backend Engineer on the Duo Chat team, focused on Chat Engine, you'll build the core AI capabilities behind GitLab Duo Chat, the natural-language and agentic interface to the GitLab DevSecOps platform. Much of your work will involve building flow components and agentic flows in the Flow Registry, the Python framework built on LangGraph within our Duo Workflow Service that powers agentic chat, and integrating them with the GitLab Rails monolith. 
 You'll own complex backend features from start to finish across both services. You'll integrate large language models and orchestrate multi-agent flows so customers can work faster and more securely across the software development lifecycle. This work sits where GitLab's core platform meets its AI strategy, and reliability, performance, and answer quality directly shape the customer experience. 
  What you’ll do  
 
 Design and build flow components and agentic flows in the Flow Registry using Python and LangGraph within the Duo Workflow Service. These reusable building blocks power agentic Duo Chat and, increasingly, other AI features across GitLab. 
 Develop, ship, and maintain backend features for GitLab Duo Chat across the Python Duo Workflow Service and the GitLab Rails monolith in a secure, well-tested, and performant way. 
 Integrate new generative AI models, providers, tools, and multi-agent orchestration patterns into Duo Chat to expand its capabilities and improve answer quality. 
 Design, implement, and review GraphQL and Representational State Transfer (REST) application programming interfaces (APIs) and related monolith logic, including chat entry points, permissions, and foundational-flow registration. Keep contracts with frontend clients and host systems reliable and clear. 
 Improve debugging, observability, and test coverage using pytest, RSpec, and related frameworks; track and improve latency, error rates, and test coverage so AI-powered chat workflows stay reliable at scale. 
 Collaborate with Product, User Experience (UX), frontend, and AI specialists to refine requirements and deliver high-quality improvements through iteration. 
 Document standards, patterns, and learnings with other engineers, raising the bar for safe AI integration and evidence-driven engineering. 
 Participate in Tier 2 on-call rotations to troubleshoot production issues, contribute to root cause analysis, and strengthen resiliency. 
 
  What you’ll bring  
 
 Significant experience building and maintaining production Python backends, including APIs, data models, and asynchronous or long-running workloads.

5. 具有优秀的沟通能力和团队协作能力，富有工作激情、创作欲望和责任感，能承受高强度的工作压力； 
6. 熟练使用Photoshop、AE等相关软件，掌握界面原型、流程、动效的交互设计方法； 
7. 有较丰富的单机游戏体验，尤其在动作冒险和角色扮演向作品方面有深刻体验，总体验时长不低于200小时，体验作品数量不少于8部。 1. 根据策划需求，协助设计出合理的交互解决方案，从功能和形式等多个方面协助提升设计质量；
2. 配合开发制作，与美术、程序合作将交互功能开发上线；

4. 除了纯UI向的交互工作，还能够在单机体验层面的交互上去深入，定义单机交互全新维度； 
5. 能与上下游职位良好配合，把握需求，向视觉设计师和程序沟通传递设计思想； 
6. 具备较好的原型制作能力，能够使用ue5制作简单的原型资源和简单动效。

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Ruby), Plan: Portfolio Experience
jd_text:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. 
 The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems.  Co-create the future with us  as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. 
 * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.     An overview of this role  
 We're hiring a Senior Backend Engineer for GitLab's  Portfolio Experience team . You'll be an experienced product engineer who incorporates user needs into feature decisions and brings full stack experience, with a current focus on backend. You'll spend as much time understanding user needs and shaping how features should work as you do building them, working directly with product, users, and open source contributors. 
 You'll help evolve the backend architecture that powers the work items platform, which must serve millions of work items in a single user's view across tens of thousands of groups and projects. 
  What you’ll do  
 
 Collaborate with product and other engineers to shape requirements, understand user needs, and break complex projects into shippable iterations. 
 Design and implement backend and real-time features in the GitLab monolith, including GraphQL and RESTful APIs and subscriptions, with a focus on performance, reliability, and user impact. 
 Build and evolve portfolio planning capabilities, including work item hierarchy, status rollup, and capacity planning. 
 Improve PostgreSQL performance at scale through query and write optimization, indexing, denormalization, partitioning, and moving suitable workloads to Elasticsearch or ClickHouse. 
 Create proofs of concept for complex work, maintain extensive automated test coverage, and support safe rollouts with feature flags and strong observability. 
 Mentor engineers and open source contributors through code reviews, pairing, regular feedback, contributor issues, and hackathons. 
 Participate in on-call rotations, troubleshoot production issues, contribute to root cause analysis, and improve the team's development and review processes. 
 
  What you’ll bring  
 
 Experience representing the user perspective while working through trade-offs with product managers, engineers, and users. 
 Experience leading projects involving several engineers over multiple months and supporting others through thoughtful code reviews, feedback, hiring, career development, and mentoring. 
 Full stack experience with a current backend focus, including proficiency with Ruby and Ruby on Rails and an understanding of how complex modern frontends work.

 Site Reliability Engineers keep GitLab's user-facing services and production systems running reliably at scale. jd_text:
你将负责：
玩转全平台内容：从微信公众号深度长文、抖音15秒高能快剪，到B站技术向Vlog、YouTube海外种草——你来策划、写稿、剪辑（或协调设计），让智能工程机械被看见、被讨论、被向往；
引爆行业展会：参与宝马展（bauma）、BICES等国际顶级工程机械展——从展台创意脑暴、互动装置设计，到现场直播、客户打卡引导、会后传播复盘，你就是“线下流量操盘手”；
做工程师“翻译官”：深入产品一线，把SLAM算法、自主作业、边缘计算这些“技术黑话”，翻译成客户看得懂、年轻人愿意转的高价值内容（图文/视频/案例故事）；
成为团队“连接器”：联动产品、技术、销售，推动品牌声量→线索转化→项目落地，让市场不只是“发稿”，更是业务增长引擎。 ——别只做“打工人”，来做“钢铁巨兽”的代言人！

你以为工程机械=灰头土脸？
在我们这儿，挖掘机能自动驾驶，装载机自动上料，矿卡在无人矿区自己跑单——
我们要找的，是能把这些“硬核浪漫”讲成爆款故事的人！

如果你刷B站不只是看番，还会分析百万播放视频的节奏；
如果你写文案不只会“高端大气”，还能把CAN总线写出热血感；
如果你觉得“工业4.0”比偶像剧更上头——
欢迎加入我们，用你的网感，重新定义“中国制造”的酷！
你能获得：
真实影响力：你的内容会被全球客户、行业KOL、甚至央视/36氪看到；
硬核成长：每天和算法工程师、硬件大牛、海外销售打交道，知识密度拉满；
自由创作空间：拒绝模板化宣传！鼓励试错、创新、搞事情；

1.主导腾讯云自研服务器（通用计算/Agentic AI/自研板卡）的硬件架构设计，包括主板、背板、电源、散热及互连拓扑等子系统的定义与优化；
2.负责面向云场景的PCIe板卡（如智能网卡、存储压缩卡等）硬件设计与研发，满足高性能计算与存储需求；
3.基于业务负载特性（计算/存储/网络）进行器件选型与方案权衡，输出完整的架构规格书与设计需求文档；
4.跟踪CPU、内存、PCIe/CXL、NIC、NVMe等关键器件的技术演进，推动LPDDR6、PCIe 6.0/7.0、CXL、液冷等新技术的预研与落地；
5.完成原理图与PCB Layout设计及评审，主导信号完整性(SI)和电源完整性(PI)的设计与优化；
6.设计供电(VRM/PDB)、时钟、复位、BMC/带外管理等核心电路，完成关键器件选型与参数验证；
7.制定硬件测试验证计划，主导EVT/DVT/PVT各阶段调试，解决硬件设计缺陷与验证问题；
8.执行信号完整性、电源质量、可靠性（HALT/HASS/高低温/振动）等全维度测试验证；
9.协同结构与热设计团队，完成风冷/液冷散热方案及机械结构的适配与优化；
10.与软件/固件（BIOS/BMC/OS/FPGA）、数据中心基础设施、采购供应链团队深度协作；
11.支持现网硬件故障分析(FA)、根因定位及改进方案落地，降低现网故障率。

3.能够指导分镜团队完成全部分镜设计，审核分镜脚本的叙事逻辑与镜头语言，通过动态分镜提前验证创作方案；

6.与制片团队共同制定项目排期与里程碑计划，预判制作风险并制定应对方案，推动制作管线的持续优化；
7.深度理解王者荣耀 IP 世界观与核心用户诉求，把握艺术表达与商业目标的平衡，关注行业趋势与竞品动态，持续提升创作视野与品质标杆。

title: 视频广告设计实习生
jd_text:
【工作要求】
1. 大三及以上在校学生，多媒体应用相关专业优先，有信息流广告制作经验优先。
2. 每周出勤不少于四天，实习期 4 个月以上（6 个月以上优先）。
3. 熟练使用 AE（要求能套改模板、制作动效、制作新版式）、PR、剪映等剪辑软件，掌握 PS 的基本操作，能使用AI工具生图、生视频、制作数字人口播视频者优先。
4. 对广告素材有钻研进取的态度，有良好的沟通与学习能力，善于独立思考，乐于分享。
5. 符合网易企业文化：为热爱全心投入；和用户在一起；从 0 到 1 是创新，从 1 到 1.1 也是。
【岗位回报】
1. 深度参与到海外广告素材的全链路制作，快速积累多行业广告制作经验。使用团队内部成熟的创意生产工具与素材管理平台，学习业界领先的广告制作工作流。
2. 入职享系统化培训，精进软件技能，掌握海外投放广告设计逻辑，实习满4个月可获得网易实习证明。
3. 网易饭堂、活动下午茶、健身房团操课、内部公开课、节假日各类活动等。
上班时间：9:30~18:30 （周一至周五）
上班地点：广州市天河区科韵路16号广州信息港E栋网易大厦
投递简历同时发送至：
liuziying@corp.netease.com
zhangjianliang01@corp.netease.com
请尽量以PDF格式投递简历及作品集，邮件标明“视频广告设计实习生-姓名”。 需要熟练掌握【AE】（要求能套改模板、制作动效、制作新版式），简历合适者将收到笔试邀请。
【工作内容】
1. 为社交、AI工具、游戏、电商等产品制作投放至Facebook、TikTok等海外媒体的广告素材，涵盖了解产品、洞察用户、创意设计、收集素材、后期剪辑、动效包装、图片制作等全链路环节，广告形式以短视频为主。
2. 了解中东、欧美、东南亚、日韩等地区的用户偏好与文化差异，收集对应素材，制作符合海外本地化审美的广告素材。
3. 持续追踪海外各行业的优质广告素材，对投放素材进行多版本迭代，以提升点击率、转化率等为目标。

title: 跨境物流A段综合结算-TikTok
jd_text:
1、薪资核算与结算管理：负责A段劳务派遣员工的薪资核算全流程工作，包括考勤数据核对、工时统计、绩效核算、补贴扣款核算，确保薪资数据精准、核算零差错，按时完成月度薪资结算工作；
2、数据处理与台账维护：熟练处理各类薪资、用工数据，整理、汇总、分析劳务员工用工及薪资数据；建立并维护完善的劳务人员薪资结算台账、用工台账，保证数据真实、完整、可追溯，定期完成数据归档工作；
3、跨部门沟通协作：承担跨部门对接工作，常态化对接各业务部门，同步核对员工出勤、工时、绩效、异动等用工信息，及时确认薪资核算依据；对接财务部门，同步结算数据、核对账目，配合财务完成服务商费用核算、账务核销、票据对接等相关工作；
4、问题答疑与异常处理：负责解答业务部门及外包员工关于薪资结算、工时核算、薪资发放的各类疑问；及时排查薪资核算过程中的数据异常、账目差异等问题，快速联动相关部门协调解决，保障结算工作有序推进；
5、流程落地优化与专项工作：严格执行公司劳务用工结算、薪资管理相关制度，规范结算工作流程；日常梳理核算及对接过程中的痛点问题，主动提出流程优化建议，提升薪资结算及跨部门协作效率；配合完成劳务用工盘点、薪资专项核查、年度结算复盘等临时性工作，完成上级交办的其他相关任务。

title: BPO运营管理专家-会计与报告
jd_text:
1、负责外包供应商的全生命周期管理，包括考核评估、日常运营、淘汰优化等，持续提升外包交付质量与服务效率；
2、负责外包项目的运营管理，结合业务需求制定外包支持方案，推动需求承接、过程跟进、结果复盘等全流程落地；
3、搭建并持续完善外包管理机制，包括供应商管理规范、服务标准、流程制度、考核指标及结算规则，推动运营标准化与精细化；
4、对招聘外包交付数据进行监控、分析与复盘，围绕交付效率、到岗质量、成本投入、渠道转化等指标输出分析结论与优化建议；
5、协同采购、财务BP、内控等相关团队，推进外包合作过程中的合同履约、风险控制、费用结算及异常问题处理，识别外包运营中的关键问题与潜在风险，推动流程优化、资源整合及系统能力建设，不断提升外包整体支持能力；
6、关注行业趋势及外包市场变化，结合业务发展需求，持续优化供应商结构与合作模式。

title: 游戏技术美术（动画向）

1、5年以上的游戏业界技术动画从业经验

4、对镜头表现、相机动画、角色操作体验有一定的审美与想法。
5、良好的学习与钻研能力，关注行业前沿，快速跟进新技术。
6、为动画美术开发各类工具，协助美术提高动画的制作质量和效率，解决遇到的各类技术问题。

title: 快乐猴-湖州门店店长
jd_text:
1、确保公司营运标准高效在门店落地，提升销售与毛利；
2、理解商圈和用户，据此对门店品类和商品经营方向有清晰的认知，通过品类/商品经营、拉新、营销、门店布局、商品订货、陈列、服务，售后，库存管控等；
3、管控店内损耗、提升门店人效，优化可控费用（如物料，水电煤等营运费用），达成主要考核KPI；
4、对内各协同部门的日常高效交互，达成共识，高效执行总部和区域新项目落地；
5、对外关系的建立维护，如相关政府职能部门（市场管理、消协等）、物业关系，打造协作融洽的合作伙伴。 1、具有传统大型零售运营的思维模式，5年以上工作经验，担任过2年以上传统实体零售门店生鲜副店长及以上级别的管理岗,关注客户价值和客户体验;
2、诚实正直、品行端正、责任心强、肯吃苦、有激情且执行力强，有商人视角；
3、勇于承担，乐于分享，指导与培养团队各项能力，能够打造高绩效团队，形成阶梯化人才成长模式；
4、具备建设组织和体系搭建能力，可以制定并落实各环节的流程。
5、掌握基本的AI工具，具备数字化运营思维，能快速学习并应用AI辅助工具提升工作效率。

dept.name: 食杂零售-快乐猴事业部

title: 美团外卖-供应链采购专家
jd_text:
1、寻商：基于用户需求预测，输出品类备货计划，根据上游菜品研发的食材清单要求和标准，寻找匹配需求的工厂、供应商。
2、菜品：联动菜品研发，与供应商研发对接，进行定品和议价，输出采购方案，持续推动商品统采。
3、议价：通过竞标等流程，拿到供应商最优价格，并持续原料采购价格优化。
4、供应商管理：联动品控，对合作商的产品做品质监督管理，保障商品稳定性，以及联动商管，通过商管政策对合作商继续做合规化管理，保障供应链的高效运转。 
5、履约仓储对接：对接供应商、仓配厂商，推动履约链路搭建，保障商品从工厂到门店的履约时效和效率、成本最优。 1、大学本科及以上学历。
2、在餐饮品牌、食材供应链平台等，从事零售3R大单品等优先，有采购经验。
3、有供应链资源。
4、具备创业精神，积极主动，有较强的自驱力。
